QUOTE: "`ServerManager::execute` ... `PermissionManager::is_denied(deny list) → error JSON, tool not run`" and "The deny list is enforced later, inside `ServerManager::execute`, so deny still wins even when `auto_approve` is true or the tool is allow-listed."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says deny is enforced in ServerManager::execute, but it also describes other gates (anti-spiral block, schema, MCP authorization, tier allowed_tools, duplicate, and an approval refusal when no callback is set). So it doesn't conclude that the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution.
